items.headline: Goldman Sachs Predicts RBI Repo Rate to Hit 6.25% by Mid-2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs anticipates the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to increase the repo rate by an additional 75 basis points by mid-2027, including a projected 25 basis point hike in December 2026 and a further 50 basis points in the first half of 2027, bringing the benchmark rate to 6.25%.

items.headline: India's Retail Inflation Breaches RBI's 6% Tolerance in October, Hits 6.09%
items.summary: India's retail inflation (CPI) increased to 6.09% in October 2026, surpassing the RBI's 6% tolerance threshold, with food inflation spiking to 8.94%. Economists expect further repo rate increases.

items.headline: Indian Markets See Sharp Correction as Global AI Sell-off Weighs
items.summary: Indian markets experienced a sharp correction on Monday, November 23, 2026, with Sensex falling 1.77% and Nifty 50 declining 1.75%, influenced by a global sell-off in AI-linked stocks and concerns over tighter US monetary policy.

items.headline: Global Tech Rebound Provides Positive Cues for Indian Markets Ahead of Reopening
items.summary: Despite recent declines, US stock futures rose and Asian markets saw significant rebounds in tech and chip shares on Tuesday, November 24, potentially offering positive cues for Indian markets when trading resumes.

items.headline: Nifty-500 Companies Report Strongest Earnings Growth in 12 Quarters for Q2 FY27
items.summary: Motilal Oswal Financial Services reported that Nifty-500 companies posted an aggregate adjusted net profit of Rs 5.14 lakh crore in Q2 FY27, a 32% year-on-year increase, driven by robust demand and operational performance.

items.headline: MRPL, Max Financial, Nestle Among Key Companies to File Q2 FY27 Results
items.summary: Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals (MRPL), Max Financial Services (MFSL), Paradeep Phosphates (PARADEEP), Nestle India (NESTLEIND), Meesho, Piramal Finance, and Narayana Hrudayalaya recently filed their Q2 FY27 earnings.

items.headline: Metal Sector Plummets 4.17% Amid Commodity Price Concerns; Tata Steel Down 8.16%
items.summary: The Metal sector was the worst performer on Monday, November 23, plunging 4.17% due to concerns over commodity prices and demand outlook, with Tata Steel seeing an 8.16% decline.

items.headline: Nifty IT Sector Rallies 1.69% on Positive Global Tech Sentiment
items.summary: The Nifty IT sector was the top performer on Monday, gaining 1.69%, buoyed by positive global technology sentiment and selective stock-specific rallies.

items.headline: Zee Entertainment Buyback, Rights Issues, Dividends Set for Record Dates This Week
items.summary: Nine companies have set record dates for corporate actions this week (November 23-27), including a share buyback by Zee Entertainment Enterprises, four rights issues, three dividends, and a stock split by Varvee Global.

items.headline: PB Fintech Surges, Tata Steel & APL Apollo Tumble Amidst Market Volatility
items.summary: PB Fintech was a top gainer, surging 6.82%, while Tata Steel fell 8.16% and APL Apollo Tubes tumbled 21.39% in recent trading sessions.

items.headline: Coforge Launches New AI Operating System
items.summary: IT major Coforge has launched an Artificial Intelligence Operating System, indicating its strategic focus on advanced technology solutions.

items.headline: RailTel Secures    32.74 Crore Order
items.summary: RailTel Corporation of India has secured a new order worth    32.74 crore, bolstering its project pipeline and revenue prospects.
